sentences.text: The provided in-force directions do not state a maximum interest rate for MSE loans.

The in-force UCB directions that apply here say a UCB may charge interest on unpaid interest, including unpaid EMI, at the contracted rate of interest until remediation, and not at a penal rate of interest.
The same directions also set pre-payment-charge rules for floating-rate business loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises, but they do not give an interest-rate ceiling.

I did not find any evidence for a maximum ordinary interest rate on MSE business loans, and I searched the in-force UCB directions on interest, penal interest, pre-payment charges, and microfinance rate disclosure.
